fact: Car 23 was driven erratically in an incident involving Car 6 at Turn 17
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 23 (Alexander Albon), team representative and reviewed video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. Both cars were approaching Turn 17, with Car 23 (ALB) ahead of Car 6 (HAD). Car 23 was weaving to try keeping temperature in the tyres and preparing for his next flying lap. Car 6 approached from behind at a significantly higher speed, with a speed differential of approximately 60 km/h. As the cars approached Turn 17, Car 23 moved towards the inside of the corner to take his normal racing line, but into the path of Car 6. The driver of Car 6 had to brake heavily to avoid a collision. The driver of Car 23 explained that he was preparing for his next flying lap and needed to maintain tyre temperature while also managing his battery status. He stated that he had not expected Car 6 to close so quickly. The Stewards considered the movements of Car 23, the significant speed differential between the two cars and the need for Car 6 to take evasive action. In particular, the Stewards examined whether the driving of Car 23 was unpredictable or potentially dangerous, taking into account the circumstances of his preparation for the following lap. The Stewards acknowledged that weaving to maintain tyre temperature is common when preparing for a flying lap. However, drivers must remain aware of approaching traffic and ensure that their movements do not create potentially dangerous situations. In this case, Car 23 moved towards the inside of Turn 17 while Car 6 was approaching at a significantly higher speed, forcing the driver of Car 6 to brake heavily to avoid contact. The Stewards considered this movement to be unpredictable and potentially dangerous, irrespective of the driver's intention to prepare for his next The Stewards flying lap. The Stewards therefore determined that the driving of Car 23 constituted erratic driving and imposed a driving reprimand.
stewards: drivers must remain aware of approaching traffic
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code

title: Infringement Car 23 Erratic Driving In Turn 17
